앞에서 블라인드만 맞춘 상대가 있습니다. 강한 패로 레이즈하면 더 약한: Someone has already called the blind. Raising with a strong hand can get calls from weaker ones.
아직 레이즈한 사람이 없습니다. 내 자리와 뒤에 남은 사람 수를 기준으로: Nobody has raised yet. Choose your opening range based on position and the players left to act.
칩으로 올렸습니다. 강한 패는 재레이즈로 팟을 키울 수 있고, 콜하면 뒤: chips. A reraise builds the pot with strong hands. A call lets players behind come along.
레이즈가 겹칠수록 상대가 남길 패도 강해집니다. 내 패의 예상 지분과 추: Each new raise narrows the range you face. Compare your equity against that range with the chips it costs to continue.
칩입니다. 내가 받을 수 있는 팟을 기준으로 상대 범위에 대한 예상 지분: more. Compare your equity against the opponent's range with the price of the pot you can actually win.
첫 액션에서 폴드할 패 고르기: Choosing what to fold first in
아직 블라인드 외에는 들어온 칩이 없습니다. 이 자리에서는 더 강한 패로: Only the blinds are in. This position favors opening with stronger hands.
두 보드의 지분을 합쳐 판단하기: Combine your equity on both boards
각 보드가 팟의 절반을 가져갑니다. 한쪽만 이기면 반 팟이므로, 두 보드: Each board pays half. Use average equity across both boards when you
compare the cost of a call.
앞에서 체크한 뒤 베팅을 받았습니다. 강한 패 일부로 지금 레이즈하면 상: You checked and faced a bet. Raising some strong hands discourages opponents from betting every weak hand.
콜해도 개선될 여지가 있고 레이즈로 상대를 폴드시킬 수도 있습니다. 상대: A call can improve; a raise can win a fold. Lean toward calling against players who rarely fold.
현재 추정 지분이 손익분기점보다 낮습니다. 뒤에서 레이즈가 나올 수 있거: Your estimated equity is below the break-even point. Be especially wary of raises behind you or limited implied odds.
콜 가격과 다음 액션 비교하기: Compare the call price and next action

리버에는 다음 카드가 없습니다. 상대가 이 크기로 블러프할 패까지 생각해: There are no more cards to come. Consider which bluffs the opponent would bet for this size.
You can see your opponent act first on the next street.

내 뒤에 행동할 상대가 있습니다. 강한 패와 좋은 드로도 일부 체크해야: Players still act behind you. Checking some strong hands and draws leaves room for check-raises.
여러 명이 남으면 모두를 폴드시킬 확률이 낮습니다. 베팅 전 어떤 약한: Against several players, it is harder to make everyone fold. Consider who can call worse and who might raise.
상대가 먼저 행동합니다. 약한 패의 콜을 받을 때 베팅하고 중간 세기의: Your opponent acts first. Bet when worse hands can call, or check a medium-strength hand toward showdown.

쉬는 시간에 가게 기타를 튜닝해 줬다가 매주 한 곡 맡게 됐다. 신청곡은: Kyung-tae tuned the pub guitar over a break and inherited a weekly song slot. Requests are welcome, but only the intro gets played.
The chip ticking under a fingernail goes silent when the opponent checks the turn.
창가 화분 잎 하나가 유리에 닿으면 사흘 안에 자리를 바꿔 준다. 단골들: When a leaf reaches the window, A-ram moves the plant within three days. Regulars use it as a seasonal calendar.
Counts live cards instead of faces to see how many players remain.
입상 사진에서 눈 감은 사람이 나오면 한 장 더 찍자고 우긴다. 정작 자: Dae-soo insists on retaking prize photos if somebody blinks. In the personal champion's photo, both eyes are half shut.
Narrows the eyes to fit the whole board into one imagined frame.
누가 큰 팟을 이겨도 퇴근길 라디오 사연처럼 짧게 정리한다. 바텐더는 선: Sun-woo describes each big pot like a listener's letter on the drive home. The bartender likes the stories about losing the best.
작게 베팅하기 전 칩 세 장을 꺼냈다가 그중 한 장을 제자리로 돌려놓곤: Takes out three chips for a small bet, then puts one back.
I'll tell you the ending in a minute.
Keeps the pressure on when deep.
Jin-kyung tipped a lampshade a fingertip to keep glare off a card. Nobody has touched that lamp since.
칩 더미 뒤에 손을 세워 조명 반사를 가린다. 그제야 맞은편 스택 끝까지: Shades the chip stacks with a hand to see the far side.
Takes low connectors to the flop.
단골이 준 귤 한 상자를 펍에 가져온 날, 껍질을 제일 길게 깎은 사람이: Woo-seok brought in a case of tangerines from a customer. Whoever peeled the longest strip got out of doing the dishes.
낮은 숫자가 연달아 나오면 빈 귤껍질부터 옆으로 민다. 시야를 넓히는 셈: Pushes the peel aside when low cards come out together.
Give me one tangerine's worth of time.
Reads changes in raise size closely.
펍을 처음 보러 왔을 땐 줄자를 들고 있었다. 의뢰는 끝났지만 의자 폭을: Se-ra first visited the pub with a tape measure for a job. Every Friday there's apparently another chair to measure.
콜하기 전에 상대가 꺼낸 칩과 자기 앞 칩을 높이가 같게 나란히 대 본다: Lines up the caller's chips beside the opponent's to compare their heights.
Two stacks are easier to read.
Steals the blinds from the button.
펍 오픈 때부터 같은 요일에 온다. 수강생이 합주를 잘 끝낸 날엔 기분이: Sang-wook has come on the same night since opening week. A good band practice can put the teacher in the mood for requests.
폴드가 자기 앞까지 이어지면 발끝으로 박자를 짚는다. 네 번째 박에 고개: Counts folds with a toe tap and lifts the head on the fourth beat.
I'll come in first this time.
직접 만든 얇은 책을 늘 두 권씩 들고 온다. 한 권은 읽으라고, 다른: So-dam brings two handmade books, one for reading and one for shimming a wobbly bar table.
Unfolds the tournament slip near the money and points to the players left.
한 페이지 남았다고 급히 넘겨요?: Would you rush the last page?
퇴근 뒤 헬멧을 걸 데가 없어 의자 아래 고리를 직접 달았다. 지금은 다: Gyu-sung installed a helmet hook under a chair after work. Other riders beat the installer to that seat these days.
턴을 기다릴 땐 엄지와 검지로 원을 그리며 칩 하나를 자전거 바퀴처럼 돌: Spins a chip like a bicycle wheel while waiting for the turn.
Two roads? I'll try one first.
Checks strong hands to disguise them.
펍 테이블 색을 맞춰 오겠다며 조색한 종이를 여섯 장 가져왔다. 아침빛: An-na brought six paint swatches to match the felt and took them all home. Apparently the morning light changes everything.
먼저 체크하고 나면 두 손을 무릎에 올려놓고 상대가 움직일 때까지 기다린: After checking, rests both hands in the lap until an opponent acts.
There's a little yellow in that green.
펍 벽시계가 자꾸 늦어 바늘을 갈아 줬다. 대회 시간이 밀릴 때마다 딜러: Jung-pil replaced the hands on the slow wall clock. Whenever the tournament runs late, the dealer gives the watchmaker a look.
보드가 짝지어지면 높은 카드부터 작은 소리로 센다. 마지막 한 장에서 멈: On paired boards, counts down from the high cards under the breath.
끝에 붙은 게 뭐였죠?: What was the last one again?
Uses small bets to gather information.
영업 뒤 남은 원두로 딜러에게 작은 커피 한 잔을 내려 준다. 설탕 넣는: Mi-joo makes the dealer an espresso with the beans left after closing. Names sometimes slip, but the number of sugar spoons never does.
상대가 칩을 만질 때마다 컵 손잡이를 반 바퀴 돌린다. 커피가 식어도 그: Turns the cup handle half a turn each time an opponent touches chips.
기차에서 길을 알려 준 손님과 당산펍에서 다시 만났다. 둘은 서로 이름을: Jun-hyuk met a train passenger again at the pub. The two used carriage numbers before finally asking each other's names.
Counts the seats still to act, skipping empty chairs in order.
Too early to get off here.
바 의자에 외투를 걸면 흘러내린다며 무릎에 반듯하게 접는다. 다른 손님: Hyun-seo folds a jacket neatly on the lap to keep it off the floor. Once missed a turn folding the next player's coat as well.
Straightens the first crooked stack after a fold.
I'll take care of that small one.
Waits for chances to scoop both boards.
접이식 테이블을 빌려줬다가 반납받으러 온 날 첫 더블보드를 배웠다. 그: Dong-jin learned double board while collecting a folding table lent to the pub. It still stands at the front of the storeroom.
두 보드 사이에 시선을 두고 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 두 줄을 번갈아 따라간다: Tracks the two boards left to right, alternating rows.
Let's see the bottom one too.
단골들이 의자를 밀 때 나는 소리로 짧은 안무를 만든 적이 있다. 영상을: Na-ri once choreographed a short dance to the sound of pub chairs scraping. Ask for the video and the premiere is always coming soon.
새 플랍이 나오면 레일을 짚던 양손을 떼고 오른발을 의자 안쪽으로 넣는다: Lifts both hands off the rail and tucks the right foot in on a fresh flop.
Enters big pots with a narrow range.
안경에 흠이 하나 있어 작은 숫자를 볼 때만 고개를 살짝 돌린다. 안경은: A scratch on Jung-min's glasses makes small numbers easier to read at an angle. Same glasses, third case.
Lowers the glasses and looks for the most valuable chip color in a big pot.
Look first before touching the big one.
펍 칠판에 띄어쓰기가 틀린 날이면 주문 한 줄 안 해도 온 걸 알 수 있: A corrected space on the pub chalkboard gives Yeon-hee away even before ordering. The dealer's odd nickname is always left as written.
족보를 들을 때 카드를 들추는 손이 잠깐 멎는다. 상대 이름까지 다 듣고: Waits for the dealer to finish the hand and the player's name before turning cards over.
Listen to the end. It changes the meaning.
Looks up players who rarely reach showdown.
펍 문 닫는 소리를 녹음해 영화의 낡은 극장 문에 썼다. 단골 한 명이: Si-on recorded the pub door for a film set in an old theater. One regular recognized the sound at the cinema.
큰 팟 뒤에는 사람들이 칩을 거두는 소리가 잦아들어야 자기 칩을 정리한다: Waits for a big pot's clatter to die down before stacking chips.
I'll stay to hear the last note.
Makes thin value bets on rivers.
대진표에 이름을 쓸 때마다 펜이 달라진다. 지고 돌아간 밤에도 그날의 잉: Tae-kyung uses a different pen on each sign-up sheet and records the day's ink color, even after a losing night.
리버에서는 작은 칩 몇 개를 먼저 골라 펜촉 고르듯 색깔순으로 늘어놓는다: On rivers, arranges a few small chips in order like a selection of nibs.
Picks up pots from good position.
손님이 자리를 비우면 물잔부터 안쪽으로 민다. 펍에 쉬러 온 날조차 습관: Ji-soo moves unattended glasses in from the edge. Once the dealer handed over an apron on what was meant to be a night off.
물잔이 레일에 가까우면 자기 차례라도 먼저 옮긴다. 한 뼘 거리를 꼭 지: Before taking a turn, moves any glass within a handspan of the rail.
칩 파우치를 양복 자투리 천으로 지었다. 안감이 전부 달라서 서로 바꿔: Kyung-soo makes chip pouches from suit offcuts. The linings differ and the regulars still compare them.
큰 드로를 보면 칩 더미 양 끝을 엄지와 중지로 재 본다. 줄자는 꺼내지: Measures the stack between thumb and middle finger when a big draw arrives.
Counts opponents first in big pots.
비가 오면 가게 문 앞 나무 냄새부터 맡는다. 펍에선 누가 먼저 들어왔는: Ye-rim smells the wood outside the shop on rainy days. At the pub the first thing noticed is which window is open.
두 명 이상 남은 팟에서는 각자 앞에 남은 카드 뒷면을 한 번씩 눈으로: Checks the backs of each player's live cards in a multiway pot.
Commits when well ahead on one board.
가게 셔터에 남은 페인트로 펍 자전거 거치대를 칠했다. 무슨 색이냐고 물: Gyu-tae painted the pub bicycle rack with leftover paint from a shutter. To find out the color, come at sunset.
두 보드 중 먼저 읽은 쪽은 고무 매트 이음새에 엄지를 대고 표시해 둔다: Marks the board already read with a thumb on the mat seam.
I'm not letting the top one go.
Waits patiently with a deep stack.
독서실 마감 때 고쳐 놓은 의자 개수를 핸드폰에 기록한다. 펍 첫날에는: So-young logs the chairs fixed at closing on a phone. On the first pub visit a neighbor nearly got asked to keep a phone call quiet.
Breathes in slowly when the clock starts and lays the stack in a row.
Targets rivers opponents have given up on.
동네 극장의 마지막 회차가 끝나야 나타난다. 누가 결말을 물으면 빈 컵을: Pil-sung only appears after the local cinema's last show. Ask for the ending and an upturned glass announces that the screening is over.
마지막 카드가 깔리면 안경을 고쳐 쓰고 딜러 버튼 쪽부터 천천히 고개를: Adjusts the glasses on the river, then turns slowly toward the button.
One more scene before the lights.
Once the first crate is on ice, sets aside the coins for tonight's tournament.
Writes blind times beside showtimes in an old notebook.
Cut a leather mat by hand to soften the clatter of chips.
Rolls both wrists before settling in for a long session.
Stops tapping a shoe the instant the river lands.
Uses chips of other colors to mark earlier open sizes.
Smooths the ticket corners with a thumbnail.
Carries a folded group photo inside a phone case.
Uses a pocket mirror to remove powder from the glasses at breaks.
Knows the last departures by heart and stands up before the break sounds.
Brings two rows of honey cookies in a lunchbox on long tournament days.
The shuffle of a deck helps tired sanding hands relax.
Produces a short-brimmed cap whenever a seat gets the glare.
Takes off the headphones to hear the neighboring seats before a tournament.
An old scissors habit makes two chips open and close between the fingers.
Scans the whole table before the first deal.
Considers an evenly printed blind board a lucky sign.
After a field day on the Han River, spends extra time reading the board.
Can fit a neat chip stack into even a cramped corner of the table.
Inherited a small inlaid card protector from a grandmother.
Can tell a stack's value by running long fingers along its top.
Records the hardest hand at the break with a personally repaired pen.
The tournament ticket always turns up at the same page in a book.
Uses an old button as a card protector.
Picks out the action at this seat even when several tables announce at once.
Leaves a small jar of honey with the bartender after a tournament.
A rolled sleeve coming loose is the first sign of a long session.
Always notices how gently someone tosses their folded cards.
Briefly closes one eye to read the board as if focusing a camera.
Straightens a row of chips the moment one slips out of line.
Plays silent chords on a knee with the left hand while thinking.
Checks twice for damp fingertips before the deal.
Books the window seat for next week whenever it opens up.
Arrives on time, helmet in hand, even in the rain.
Repeats a price under the breath once before putting chips in.
Can spot a hairline crack in a cup and still look up in time to act.
